summary: Tested MoltBot Studio Component Presets feature: 4 Preset buttons (KPI/Card/Table/Button) in Smart Binding panel, one-click card addition, card/field editing, and full Publish flow (Visual Diff + Pre-Publish Checklist + Confirm Publish). All features working correctly on Desktop and Mobile.
context_for_next_testing_agent: MoltBot Studio Component Presets feature fully tested. All 4 preset buttons work, publish flow works, no console errors for 'Failed to fetch customizations'.

preset_buttons_visible.details: All 4 Preset buttons (Preset KPI, Preset Card, Preset Table, Preset Button) visible in Smart Binding panel on both Desktop and Mobile

preset_kpi_adds_card.details: Clicking 'Preset KPI' button adds a new card 'مؤشرات الأداء' with 3 fields (إجمالي الإيراد, العمليات المفتوحة, صافي الدخل)

card_field_editing.details: Card title and field label/value inputs are editable and changes are tracked

publish_flow_visual_diff.details: Clicking 'نشر' (Publish) opens Visual Diff modal showing change metrics (Labels, Contents, Styles, Assets, Hidden, Positions)

publish_flow_checklist.details: Pre-Publish Checklist shows 6 items with status badges (جاهز/تنبيه/حرج). All items showed 'جاهز' status.

publish_flow_confirm.details: Clicking 'نشر الآن' (Confirm Publish) saves changes to backend API and shows success toast. Version incremented from 5 to 7.

backend_customization_api.details: GET /api/alkabeer-bot/customization returns saved custom_cards with correct structure

backend_history_api.details: GET /api/alkabeer-bot/editor/history returns version history with published status

font_parastoo.details: Font family is 'Parastoo, "Noto Naskh Arabic", Tahoma, sans-serif' - matches site font

mobile_collab_tabs.details: Mobile collab tabs (History/Comments/Binding) visible and functional

mobile_preset_buttons.details: All 4 Preset buttons visible on Mobile (390x844)

no_horizontal_overflow.details: No horizontal overflow on Mobile (bodyScrollWidth=390, windowWidth=390)

no_fetch_errors.details: No 'Failed to fetch customizations' errors in console - error handling improved
